name: kiki-error-pulse
description: Non-blocking incremental error telemetry, normalized failure signatures, and retry-streak radar across Kiki session logs.

interface.shortDescription: Incremental tool error rates, normalized signatures, and retry streaks

zh-CN.shortDescription: 非阻塞增量报错统计、归一化错误指纹与连环撞墙定位

autoScanEnabled.title: 启用后台定时增量扫描
autoScanEnabled.description: Kiki 打开期间在后台定时读取新增 wire.jsonl 尾部，冷启动延迟首扫且不阻塞主进程。

scanIntervalMinutes.title: 后台扫描间隔（分钟）
scanIntervalMinutes.description: 定时增量扫描的时间间隔（5–1440 分钟，默认 30 分钟）。

maxScanMegabytesPerTick.title: 单轮扫描字节预算（MiB）
maxScanMegabytesPerTick.description: 单次后台扫描最多读取的新增日志字节数（2–64 MiB，默认 16 MiB），到达预算即保存游标待下轮继续。

tools.name: error_pulse_report
tools.description: Inspect incremental workspace and session error statistics, high-error tools, normalized failure signatures, retry-streak hotspots, and redacted samples from wire.jsonl logs. Use summary, top_signatures, streaks, or samples for zero-scan reads, or scan_now for a bounded incremental refresh.

action.description: summary returns window totals + top tools/signatures/streaks; scan_now runs a bounded incremental scan first; top_signatures lists normalized error clusters; streaks lists consecutive same-tool retry hotspots; samples returns redacted samples for signatureId (or top signatures).

windowHours.description: Lookback time window in hours (1..720, default 168 = 7 days).

toolFilter.description: Optional exact or case-insensitive tool / lifecycle event filter (e.g. "Bash", "Edit", "CallTool:mcp_name", "provider.error").

signatureId.description: Signature identifier (e.g. "sig_...") when inspecting samples with action="samples".

maxMegabytes.description: Optional byte budget in MiB when action="scan_now" (1..64; defaults to maxScanMegabytesPerTick setting).

reason.description: Optional brief note on why this tool is being called (ignored at runtime).
